response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_order_count, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM order_counts) SELECT SUM(oc.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(1.0 * oc.order_count / t.total_order_count) AS average_share, AVG(1.0 * oc.order_count / t.total_order_count - 1.0 / t.account_count) AS average_amount_above_share FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE oc.order_count * t.account_count > t.total_order_count;
